name: nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills
description: An Agent workflow for plotting and reviewing existing single-cell results with ncfigR and scfigR, traceable source data, checks and bounded corrections. Paper/code learning and other plotting domains are optional reference modules.

interface.shortDescription: 调用 R 包绘制已有单细胞结果，检查图件、保留源数据并按报告修正。
interface.longDescription: Plot existing annotated single-cell results through a version-checked ncfigR/scfigR runtime. The Agent inspects source contracts, executes the atlas task, reads checks, reviews exported artwork and makes bounded presentation corrections without silently changing scientific inputs. The stable workflow covers annotated embeddings, cell composition, marker expression and three feature-expression maps. Figure planning, paper/code learning and other plotting domains remain available as on-demand references, not default execution modes or equivalent validated task engines.
defaultPrompt: Use nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills to plot and review existing single-cell results through the fixed ncfigR/scfigR runtime. Inspect inputs, execute the task, review reports and artwork, then correct presentation in a new attempt. Load paper/code learning, broader figure planning or other-domain references only when the user explicitly requests them.
